name: Cakes Terminal house look
derived_from: 5 before/after pairs supplied by Guy on 2026-10-20 (Elmo, flamingo, princess, cake pops, engagement cookies)

output.format: sRGB baseline JPEG, quality 92 (stepped down only if over 1.5 MB)

framing_standing_cake.board: cake board kept fully in frame (detected by its rim edge)

framing_full_frame: close-ups fill the width with the product base in view; flat lays are center-cropped
seam: wall/table joint replaced by a smooth gradient, background only
never_touched: the cake itself: no retouching, no object removal, no straightening (done in Lightroom)
even_lighting: side-to-side light falloff (e.g. bright left fading darker to the right) is measured on the backdrop and evened out across the whole frame, cake included, so the scene reads as uniformly lit; skipped when the difference is under ~4%
ready_photos: marked 'ready to post': no changes at all, scheduled as-is
captions: describe design and occasion only - never ingredients, materials, flavors, icing or cake type
hosting: finished photos pushed to github.com/cakesterminal/media under cakes-terminal/YYYY-MM/, linked in Buffer via raw.githubusercontent.com
